definitions.gloss: every month; monthly; month by month
definitions.explanation: Each successive month, on a month-by-month basis. Used both as a noun and adverbially, most often for recurring payments or amounts.

examples.japanese: {月々|つきづき}の{支払|しはら}い。
{月々|つきづき}{一定|いってい}の{額|がく}を{貯金|ちょきん}する。
examples.english: Save a fixed amount every month.

examples.japanese: ローンは{月々|つきづき}{三|さん}{万|まん}{円|えん}ずつ{返|かえ}している。
examples.english: I'm paying back the loan at 30,000 yen a month.

notes:
Written with the iteration mark 々; the second {月|つき} is voiced to づき through {連濁|れんだく} (sequential voicing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月々|つきづき}の{支払|しはら}い: monthly payment
- {月々|つきづき}の{返済|へんさい}: monthly repayment
- {月々|つきづき}{分割|ぶんかつ}: monthly installments

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {毎月|まいつき}: every month — more neutral and common
- {月々|つきづき} emphasizes the steady, month-after-month recurrence, especially of payments and savings.
